exposure: Cervical dilation at or time to amniotomy
Use and maximum dose of oxytocin
cohort: 1,261 nulliparous patients with an unfavorable cervix and intact membranes who underwent IOL of a term, singleton gestation at a single institution from October 1, 2018, to September 30, 2020
finding: BIPOC nulliparas are 40% more likely to undergo CD during IOL than White patients, but this disparity is not explained by differences in IOL management prior to cesarean, suggesting that biases outside of induction management may be important to target to reduce CD disparities.
mod_finding: Despite finding that Black, Indigenous, and People of Color (BIPOC) patients were 40% more likely to undergo cesarean delivery during induction of labor than White patients, this difference was not explained by IOL management differences.
